Side stone engagement rings feature `smaller diamonds or gemstones placed on either side of a larger center stone to add extra sparkle and visual width`.[[1]](https://diamonds.zales.com/side-stones-engagement-rings)[[2]](https://www.robbinsbrothers.com/shop/engagement-rings/sidestone)[[3]](https://www.bluenile.com/engagement-rings/styles/diamond-sidestone)

Prices for side stone engagement rings typically range from **$1,325 to $8,150** , depending on the metal, carat total weight, and whether the stones are natural or lab-grown. You can explore collections at specialty retailers like [Zales Diamonds](https://diamonds.zales.com/side-stones-engagement-rings), [Robbins Brothers](https://www.robbinsbrothers.com/shop/engagement-rings/sidestone) , or look for options directly through [Diamonds Factory USA](https://www.diamondsfactory.com/engagement-rings/side-stone-rings).[[1]](https://diamonds.zales.com/side-stones-engagement-rings)[[2]](https://www.robbinsbrothers.com/shop/engagement-rings/sidestone)[[3]](https://www.diamondsfactory.com/engagement-rings/side-stone-rings)

### Popular Side Stone Styles

- **Trilogy / Three-Stone:** Features two prominent side stones flanking the center gem, representing the past, present, and future.
- **Baguette & Tapered Accents:** Uses elongated, step-cut side stones for a sleek, vintage, or architectural look.
- **Pavé & Halo Settings:** Surrounds the center gem with a tight frame of micro-diamonds for maximum light reflection.[[1]](https://www.diamondsfactory.com/engagement-rings/side-stone-rings)[[2]](https://stienhardt.com/collections/side-stone-diamond-engagement-rings/)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:7831798501782976092,catalogid:2110489389727748900,gpcid:4220041667065466194,mid:576462820683507911&ibp=oshop)

### Key Considerations

- **Proportion:** Side stones should complement—not overpower—the size and shape of your center diamond.
- **Metal Choice:** Platinum offers maximum durability, while yellow or rose gold adds a warm, classic contrast.
- **Total Carat Weight:** Remember that "carat total weight" includes both the center gem and all side accents combined.[[1]](https://www.bluenile.com/engagement-rings/styles/diamond-sidestone)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yRHYAy5ItDA&t=58)[[3]](https://www.diamondsfactory.com/engagement-rings/side-stone-rings)

If you'd like to narrow down your choices, tell me:

- What **center stone shape** do you prefer (round, oval, cushion, etc.)?
- What is your target **budget range**?
- Do you prefer **natural or lab-grown** diamonds?
